submitted.rationale: Out of 3 merit measurements, EQE rose sharply going toward Sb-rich compositions: 0.00052% at Co0.34 (CoSb2O6 stoichiometry), 0.0100% at Co0.19, and 0.0103% at Co0.14 (index 29, the Sb-rich end of the line). Index 29 had the highest measured EQE.
